task_type: sitewide page-loading performance diagnosis, implementation and release
requested_outcome: Make public VII navigation feel immediate by reducing real route latency, starting safe predictive work early and restoring effective anonymous document reuse without changing catalog truth or private flows.
natural_destination: The public VII routes at https://vii.spaplus.co, especially an early header-logo click from /hourly to / and repeated browsing among public worlds.
authorization_boundary: Diagnose, implement, test, commit and publish performance changes to the existing VII site. Preserve private, personalized, transactional and RSC cache exclusions; do not change DNS, credentials, catalog truth, design or indexing policy.

lesson_bundle.reason: Real speed must be proven in the natural browser journey.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Measure cold and warmed transitions and verify the affected route family.

lesson_bundle.reason: Perceived speed cannot substitute for removing causal work.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Prefer prefetch, concurrency and shared reuse over cosmetic loading alone.

lesson_bundle.reason: Mobile networks and data-saving preferences change the safe prefetch policy.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Keep save-data and 2G exclusions and verify a mobile viewport.

lesson_bundle.reason: This is a speed repair, not a visual redesign.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Preserve content, layout, routes and user-visible behavior.

lesson_bundle.reason: Shared navigation and cache policy affect a route family.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify homepage, search, hourly, spa, events and detail routes.

lesson_bundle.reason: Build and browser processes require bounded ownership and cleanup.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Record and close only task-created processes and tabs.

lesson_bundle.reason: The requested result is the public site.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Do not claim live without an exact release and post-deploy evidence.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A loader looks nicer but the click still waits seconds.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Time the exact click and change the request scheduling and server critical path.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: An already hydrated non-home route starts homepage prefetch immediately and a warmed transition reaches the homepage within 500ms in the controlled browser check.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The first click remains slow because warmup begins only when the browser becomes idle.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Start the bounded home prefetch immediately after hydration while preserving low-bandwidth exclusions.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The warmup source contains no idle callback or delayed timer and keeps Save-Data, 2G and private-route guards.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Homepage rendering still serializes an avoidable second database phase.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Overlap review-detail loading with the other independent catalog reads.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The homepage starts the properties and rated-place promises before awaiting the independent world summaries.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Cache headers exist in source but production still regenerates every public page.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Verify real response markers on the exact deployment and fail the release claim when absent.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Repeated eligible production requests report the VII cache marker; private, Cookie, Authorization and RSC requests do not.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Aggressive caching serves stale personal or booking data.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Limit reuse to anonymous public documents and catalog JSON with bounded TTLs.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Existing exclusions and Set-Cookie protection remain covered by tests.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The change helps the homepage but breaks another public route or language.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Run the route family, locale and mobile regressions before release.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Representative routes and Hebrew/English navigation remain correct without document overflow or dead links.

affected_family: shared header and internal public navigation

midpoint_gate.trigger: After immediate warmup, homepage concurrency and bounded cache policy changes are implemented locally, before publication.
checks: Static contracts prove immediate safe warmup.
Homepage data dependencies overlap without changing rendered data.
Public cache tests preserve all private and RSC exclusions.
TypeScript and focused performance tests pass.

attack_questions: Does an early click still miss warmup?
Does a cold origin response still take seconds?
Can personalized or RSC traffic enter the public cache?
Did any public route, locale or mobile layout regress?
Is the exact public release actually serving the change?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Timed browser clicks and response headers on the exact public URL.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused tests, production build, route probes and desktop/mobile browser checks across the listed family.

effectiveness.baseline: Production measured about 2772ms for an early /hourly-to-home logo click and about 205ms after a 2200ms warmup; repeated direct homepage TTFB was about 2.1 to 3.8 seconds with no VII cache marker.
effectiveness.target: Start warmup early enough for ordinary interaction, keep a warmed navigation below 500ms, reduce avoidable cold homepage work and restore verified anonymous reuse.
